title: plan::classify takes any file name under a thread's wp records as a package id
body:
`plan::classify` (plan.rs, about :630-650) takes any file name under a thread's `wp/` records directory as a package id in an add/add, unchecked.

Expected: the name is parsed with `WpId::parse`; one that is not a package id is not a PackageAddedTwice and goes to take_sides like any other path, where ingest names it UnknownFileShape after the merge (vc's ruling).

Found by ST0096's close-time catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H2-critic-rust-wp02-0709-20261122). Fixed under hv decision 86 for 3.5.1, dc's unit d86d.
